blocks.text: An applicant with a history of renal transplant must submit the following if consideration for medical certification is desired:
blocks.html: An applicant with a history of renal transplant must submit the following if consideration for medical certification is desired:

blocks.text:
- 1. Hospital admission, operative report and discharge summary
- 2. Current, detailed Clinical Progress Note report including: - The etiology of the primary renal disease - History of hypertension or cardiac dysfunction - Sequela prior to transplant - A comment regarding rejection or graft versus host disease (GVHD) - Immunosuppressive therapy and side effects, if any - The results of the following laboratory results: CBC, BUN, creatinine, and electrolytes
blocks.html:
• 1. Hospital admission, operative report and discharge summary

  • 2. Current, detailed Clinical Progress Note report including:

    • The etiology of the primary renal disease
    • History of hypertension or cardiac dysfunction

    • A comment regarding rejection or graft versus host disease (GVHD)
    • Immunosuppressive therapy and side effects, if any
    • The results of the following laboratory results: CBC, BUN, creatinine, and electrolytes
